SK01-q01-ig8jcs: Touching alone isn't enough; you must also explain what you are checking and why.
A vehicle with labeled parts cannot be used; you must know the parts yourself.
SK01-q02-vwpb3h: Verbal warnings are only for the first 2 offenses; the 3rd on the same date is automatic failure.
Interpreters are prohibited; the whole test is done in English.
SK01-q03-o2i4n1: A belt with no play is too tight; snug means 1/2 to 3/4 inch at the center.
1/4 inch is too little; a snug belt has 1/2 to 3/4 inch of play.
SK01-q04-et8evc: 2/32 inch is the minimum for all other tires; steering-axle tires need 4/32 inch.
1/2 inch is the low end of belt play, not a tread depth; steering tires need 4/32 inch.
SK01-q05-p5k6s6: Kicking a tire earns no credit; only a tire gauge counts.
Striking a tire with a mallet earns no credit; use a tire gauge.
SK01-q06-7r551q: This swaps the numbers; pump 3 times, then hold 5 seconds.
1 minute is the air brake leakage hold; the hydraulic check is pump 3, hold 5 seconds.
SK01-q07-h8mbdp: Air brake checks done wrong are not a point loss; they fail the entire vehicle inspection.
You don't repeat just the brake part; the whole vehicle inspection is failed.
SK01-q08-p5sl11: 3 psi is the limit for a single vehicle; a combination of 2 may lose 4 psi.
6 psi is for a combination of 3 or more vehicles; 2 vehicles may lose 4 psi.
SK01-q09-4xiwuh: 20 psi is in the spring brake range; the warning must come on before 55 psi.
80–85 psi is where large buses often warn; the rule is before pressure drops below 55 psi.
SK01-q10-56ebz9: 20–45 psi is where the parking brake knob pops out; cut-out is about 120–140 psi.
85–100 psi is part of the air buildup check; cut-out is about 120–140 psi.
SK01-q11-h7d9ki: You check for cracked leaves, but out of service starts when 1/4 or more are missing or broken.
Half is more than the limit; 1/4 or more missing or broken already means out of service.
SK01-q12-41yjc0: 1/2 inch is the low end of engine belt play; the manual slack adjuster pushrod limit is no more than 1 inch.
2 inches is too much; the pushrod should move no more than 1 inch.
SK01-q13-6eucj8: The colors are reversed; clearance lights are red on the rear and amber elsewhere.
Clearance lights are not white; they are red on the rear and amber everywhere else.
SK01-q14-zgrfbo: The heater is checked, but only brake lights, flashers, turn signals and horn postpone the tests.
Washers are checked, but only brake lights, flashers, turn signals and horn postpone the tests.
SK01-q15-v477of: A charged, securely mounted fire extinguisher is required emergency equipment.
3 red reflective triangles (or 6 fuses or 3 flares) are required emergency equipment.
SK01-q16-qrz8jc: You don't choose, and 1 of 3 is for Class B and C; Class A gets 1 of 4.
The examiner may test the whole vehicle or only part of it.
SK01-q17-66cgzp: Tire chains are optional equipment for any vehicle; school buses add an emergency kit and body fluid cleanup kit.
An accident reporting kit is optional; school buses add an emergency kit and body fluid cleanup kit.
SK01-q18-belx43: Half full is not the rule; the DEF tank must be more than 1/8 full.
It need not be full; more than 1/8 of the tank is enough.
SK01-q19-ypo8kz: 120–140 psi is governor cut-out; the 5 mph check tests stopping without pulling.
The knob popping out is the spring brake test, done while fanning the air down.
SK01-q20-mi8qto: No notes or instructions may be written on the inspection guide.
You may use the guide during the test; you just can't write on it.
